member.name: T:ParrotCode.Helpers.Storage.Storage
member.summary: Provides helper methods for copying files and directories.
member.remarks: This class contains high-level storage utilities for recursively copying directory contents while optionally excluding specific folders and file extensions.

member.name: M:ParrotCode.Helpers.Storage.Storage.Copy(System.String,System.String,System.String[])
member.summary: Recursively copies the contents of a directory to the specified destination.
member.param: The path of the source directory to copy.
The path of the destination directory.

An optional collection of folder names and file extensions to exclude from the copy operation. File extensions should include the leading period (for example, ".meta" or ".tmp"). Folder exclusions are matched by directory name.
member.exception: Thrown when or is , empty, or consists only of white-space characters.
Thrown when the source directory does not exist.
